subject: Handoff: safe logical-inner identity/remap fence for Gen6 early-wake experiment
body: Support sublane complete and aligned with the broad early-wake owner's 17:21Z field contract. SOURCE at main 699ed292: wakeInnerPhysicalDisplay only powers the stable physical 1968x2184 token; logicalDisplayIdsDirect already enumerates include-disabled IDs; app topologySnapshot sees only DisplayManager.displays; enableConnectedDisplayInternal and requestDisplayPowerInternal already exist; but physicalDisplayIdFromLogical is hard-coded to 1080x2520 cover geometry, so current main lacks a physical-identity fence for a hidden logical inner route. Proposed narrow fix/experiment contract: generalize logical->physical identity extraction, select exactly one 1968x2184 route whose DisplayAddress physical ID equals the stable inner physical ID, never cache the logical ID, re-enumerate and re-resolve immediately after enableConnectedDisplay, and abort before any power-stage request on ID/geometry/physical remap, ambiguity, disappearance, reversal, or terminal attempt. If platform activation makes the intended inner native/default, stop mutating and observe presentation. MODEL deterministic cases + 100,000 adversarial remap iterations PASS; no unsafe power-stage authorization after identity mismatch. PLATFORM nuance: Android 16 documents requestDisplayPower as OFF/reset oriented; STATE_UNKNOWN is the contract-aligned reset state, while STATE_ON should remain a separately field-validated Fold7 experiment rather than assumed platform guarantee. No FIELD success claim from this sublane and no production Git writes.

model.invariant: No post-enable power-stage authorization after logical-id, geometry, or physical-panel mismatch/remap
